items.title: Gemini & Zocdoc launch AI doctor booking
items.summary: Oliver Kharraz, Zocdoc Founder & CEO discusses teaming up with Google (GOOG) to integrate real-time healthcare appointment booking directly into the Gemini app, reducing patient wait times from 31 days to 72 hours while maintaining data privacy.

items.summary: Reddit shares rose 11% on S&P 500 inclusion news, even as Google's AI Overviews pressure its search traffic.

items.title: Reddit Shares Surge on S&P 500 Inclusion Later This Month
items.summary: Reddit Inc. will join the S&P 500 next week as part of an off-cycle change, S&P Dow Jones Indices said Thursday, sending the social networking platform’s shares surging more than 10% after the bell.

items.title: David Abrams's Top Second Quarter 2026 Move: Alphabet Inc at a -3.07% Portfolio Impact
items.summary: David Abrams (Trades, Portfolio), founder and CEO of Abrams Capital Management, recently submitted his 13F filing for the second quarter of 2026, revealing key adjustments to his concentrated portfolio.  Abrams established the Boston-based firm in 1999 after a decade working alongside Seth Klarman (Trades, Portfolio) at Baupost Group.  David Abrams (Trades, Portfolio) reduced his position in one stock during the quarter, with the most significant change being a reduction in Alphabet Inc (NASDAQ:GOOGL).

items.title: OpenAI's New Revenue Officer Comes From Alphabet's Wiz
